# Where the proxy resolves otherwise than dbt, one line each:
# CASE<TAB>SUBJECT<TAB>LOOKUP<TAB>REASON, as the corpus prints it.
# See tests/proxy/conformance.rs.

ambiguous-ref	model.r.c ref('z')	graph	dbt fails on two packages defining it (dbt1005); the proxy takes the first
ambiguous-ref	model.r.c ref('z')	navigation	dbt fails on two packages defining it (dbt1005); the proxy takes the first
ambiguous-source	model.r.c source('s', 't')	graph	dbt fails on two packages defining it (dbt1005); the proxy takes the first
ambiguous-source	model.r.c source('s', 't')	navigation	dbt fails on two packages declaring it (dbt1005); navigation gives both
disabled-package-model	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	graph	the scan reads no `+enabled: false`: the disabled model of the caller's package wins
disabled-package-model	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	navigation	the scan reads no `+enabled: false`: the disabled model of the caller's package wins
disabled-package-model	node:model.pa.x	scan	the scan reads no `+enabled: false` from the root's dbt_project.yml
dispatch	macro.pa.fn adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	the graph names every implementation, dbt the adapter's only
dispatch	model.r.c2 adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	dbt lists nothing for a dispatch called from a node; the graph names every implementation, dbt the adapter's only
flag-FALSE	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
flag-FALSE	model.pa.pa_m source('s', 't')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
flag-False	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
flag-False	model.pa.pa_m source('s', 't')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
flag-false	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
flag-false	model.pa.pa_m source('s', 't')	graph	graph::resolve ignores the flag (design.md, known limitations)
function	model.r.c -> function.r.double_it	scan	the scan reads no function() call
function	node:function.r.double_it	scan	the scan reads no functions
macro-unknown	node:model.r.c	scan	dbt drops a node whose macro is unknown (dbt1501); the scan keeps it
python-model	node:model.r.py_m	scan	the scan reads no Python model
ref-var	model.r.c -> model.r.x	scan	the scan reads no ref of a variable; the server's listing gives it
versions	model.pa.pc ref('m')	graph	the scan knows no versions: a ref of one answers nothing
versions	model.pa.pc ref('m')	navigation	the scan knows no versions: a ref of one answers nothing

versions	model.r.c4 ref('pa', 'm')	navigation	the scan knows no versions: a ref of one answers nothing
versions	node:model.pa.m.v1	scan	the scan knows no versions: no node per version
versions	node:model.pa.m.v2	scan	the scan knows no versions: no node per version
versions	node:model.pa.m.v3	scan	the scan knows no versions: no node per version
versions	node:model.pa.m_v1	scan	the scan knows no versions: a version's file is a model of its own
versions	node:model.pa.m_v2	scan	the scan knows no versions: a version's file is a model of its own
versions	node:model.pa.m_v3	scan	the scan knows no versions: a version's file is a model of its own
versions	node:model.r.m.v1	scan	the scan knows no versions: no node per version

versions	pa://models/_m.yml m	navigation	the scan knows no versions: the entry of a versioned model leads nowhere
versions	r://models/_m.yml m	navigation	the scan knows no versions: the entry of a versioned model leads nowhere
